findings.claim: 美國商務部2026-01-15宣布美台貿易協議：對台灣商品對等關稅上限降至15%（原20%），台灣半導體／科技業承諾在美投資至少2500億美元。搜尋結果未顯示探針卡是否適用。
findings.source: EY Tax News / 搜尋摘要（U.S.–Taiwan trade agreement, 2026-01-15）
findings.excerpt: On January 15, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce announced that the United States and Taiwan reached a trade agreement. As part of the deal, Taiwanese semiconductor and technology companies will invest at least $250 billion to expand production capacity within the United States.

findings.claim: 美國Section 232對特定先進半導體及含該等晶片之衍生產品課25%關稅，2026-01-15生效；適用範圍窄，搜尋結果未顯示探針卡／測試耗材是否被涵蓋，亦無WinWay專屬曝險資料。
findings.source: White & Case / Thomson Reuters（Section 232 semiconductor proclamation）
findings.excerpt: Imposes a 25% Section 232 tariff on a narrow set of imports of semiconductors and products containing those semiconductors that are not intended for use in the United States.

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現WinWay被列入美國Entity List或其他出口管制名單；WinWay 2026年公開申報僅見季報、股東會通知等例行文件。
findings.source: financialfilings.com WinWay 2026 filings 頁（搜尋結果）

note: 皆為產業／政策層級事實，無WinWay專屬關稅或出口管制曝險來源；第三條為查無結果之描述，as_of取查詢日。其餘：none。
